name: Track weekly completed web chat outcomes by assistant in Google Sheets

parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json;const now=new Date();const end=new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(),now.getUTCMonth(),now.getUTCDate()));const start=new Date(end.getTime()-7*86400000);return [{json:{...c,windowStart:start.toISOString(),windowEnd:end.toISOString(),runAt:now.toISOString()}}];

parameters.content:
## Web chat outcome report
Monday report for the preceding seven UTC days. Compares all completed web text chats with the unsuccessful-analysis subset, then groups counts and measured durations by assistant. Does not read voice widget calls or copy transcripts/contacts. Preview is enabled.

## Setup
Select the same Famulor History-read credential (calls:read) in both read nodes. Choose your Google Sheets connection, spreadsheet and tab. Create headers: Report key, Window start, Window end, Assistant ID, Completed chats, Unsuccessful chats, Measured chats, Average seconds. Match on Report key.

## Two bounded scans
Each scan is limited to 2,000 rows. Incomplete pages, wrong channels or a subset not contained in the first scan stop before writes. Missing durations are not counted in the average. Unsuccessful analysis may arrive later; this is not a conversion-rate or exactly-once event feed.

## Re-runs
Inspect preview rows and test the exact export in a designated sheet before disabling previewOnly. Append-or-update uses Window start + Assistant ID as Report key to update re-runs. Avoid concurrent runs and duplicate Report key values in the sheet; Sheets upsert is not a transactional uniqueness guarantee.
